title: 结点电压方程的矩阵形式 A·Y·Aᵀ·U_n = A·I_s − A·Y·U_s
statement: 电路如图（U_s1 = 10 V，I_s5 = 1 A，R_1 = 2 Ω，R_2 = R_3 = 4 Ω，R_4 = R_5 = 2 Ω，R_6 = 8 Ω）。画有向图时把 U_s1 与 R_1 的串联看成一条支路（支路 1），把 R_5 与 I_s5 的并联看成一条支路（支路 5），其余每个电阻一条支路；结点编号 1、2、3、4（4 接地），支路编号与方向见下方的有向图。
标准支路（复合支路）约定：支路 k 的电压 U_k、电流 I_k 取支路方向（关联），I_k = Y_k(U_k + U_sk) − I_sk；U_sk 的“+”极在支路终点一侧（推动电流沿支路方向流动）时为正，I_sk 的方向与支路方向**相反**时为正。
以结点 4 为参考结点（A 的行为结点 1、2、3），写出结点电压方程 Y_n·U_n = J_n，其中 Y_n = A·Y·Aᵀ，J_n = A·I_s − A·Y·U_s，求矩阵元素并解出结点电压。

questions.explain: Y_n = A·Y·Aᵀ 的对角元素 = 接在该结点上的支路导纳之和：1/2 + 1/4 + 1/8 = 0.875 S（结点 1 接支路 1、2、6）。

questions.ask: 右端 J_n 的第 1 个元素 = ?
questions.explain: J_n = A·I_s − A·Y·U_s：只有支路 1 的电压源与结点 1 有关，−a_11·Y_1·U_s1 = −(−1)(0.5)(10) = 5 A——U_s1 串 R_1 的诺顿等效电流 5 A 注入结点 1。

questions.ask: 支路 4 的电流 I_4 = ?（由 2 流向 4）

hints: 先写出 A、支路导纳矩阵 Y（对角阵）和电源向量 U_s、I_s。
相乘的结果与“观察法”一致：对角元 = 自导，非对角元 = −互导；右端 = 流入结点的电源电流（诺顿等效）。
解 3 × 3 方程组时可以先用结点 2 的方程消去 U_n2。

en.title: Node equations in matrix form A·Y·Aᵀ·U_n = A·I_s − A·Y·U_s
statement: The circuit is drawn below (U_s1 = 10 V, I_s5 = 1 A, R_1 = 2 Ω, R_2 = R_3 = 4 Ω, R_4 = R_5 = 2 Ω, R_6 = 8 Ω). In the graph, U_s1 in series with R_1 counts as one branch (branch 1), R_5 in parallel with I_s5 as one branch (branch 5), and each other resistor as one branch; the nodes are numbered 1, 2, 3, 4 (4 is grounded) and the branch numbers and directions are those of the directed graph under the circuit.

Standard (composite) branch convention: U_k and I_k follow the branch direction (associated), I_k = Y_k(U_k + U_sk) − I_sk; U_sk is positive when its "+" is toward the end of the branch (it pushes current along the branch), and I_sk is positive when it points **against** the branch direction.
With node 4 as the reference (rows of A = nodes 1, 2, 3), write the node equations Y_n·U_n = J_n with Y_n = A·Y·Aᵀ and J_n = A·I_s − A·Y·U_s, find matrix entries and solve for the node voltages.

questions.explain: Diagonal entries of Y_n = A·Y·Aᵀ are the sums of the admittances at the node: 1/2 + 1/4 + 1/8 = 0.875 S (branches 1, 2, 6 at node 1).
Only branch 6 joins nodes 1 and 3: Y_13 = −1/R_6 = −0.125 S (mutual admittances are negative).

questions.ask: Entry 1 of the right-hand side J_n = ?
questions.explain: J_n = A·I_s − A·Y·U_s: only the source of branch 1 touches node 1, −a_11·Y_1·U_s1 = −(−1)(0.5)(10) = 5 A — the Norton current of U_s1 with R_1, 5 A into node 1.
a_35·I_s5 = (+1)(1) = 1 A: I_s5 pushes 1 A up into node 3.
Solving the 3 × 3 system gives U_n = (6.8, 2.4, 2.8)ᵀ V, so U_n2 = 2.4 V.

hints: Write A, the branch admittance matrix Y (diagonal) and the source vectors U_s, I_s first.
The product agrees with the inspection method: diagonal = self-admittance, off-diagonal = minus the mutual admittance; right-hand side = source currents into each node (Norton equivalents).
For the 3 × 3 system, eliminate U_n2 with node 2's equation first.
